data.name: Halimah
data.gender_notes: Halimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that embodies the qualities of patience and forbearance, as mentioned in the Quran. The name Halimah carries the meaning “Patient, Forbearing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Halimah usually hope their child will grow to embody patient, forbearing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A virtue-oriented name, encouraging one to be patient and forgiving.
data.etymology: Halimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient, Forbearing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Halimah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: حليمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حليمة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني المرأة الحانية الرؤوفة التي تربي أولادها بعناية و حنان. ورد اسم حليمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة القصص آية 7، حيث ذكرت قصة السيدة حليمة مرضعة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم. تحمل هذه الاسم دلالات عميقة من الرأفة و الرحمة و الحنان.

in_urdu.name: حلیمة
in_urdu.meaning: حلیمة کا مطلب ہے مہربان اور فداکار خاتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: حلیمة ایک عربی मूल کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مہربان اور فداکار خاتون۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة القصص آیت 7 میں ذکر ہوا ہے، جہاں حضرت حلیمة کا ذکر ہے جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کی دائی تھیں۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقليد میں گہری اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور رحمت، شفقت اور فداکاری کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हलीमा
in_hindi.meaning: हलीमा का अर्थ है दयालु और परोपकारी महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: हलीमा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दयालु और परोपकारी महिला। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरतुल क़सस आयत 7 में उल्लेखित है, जहां हज़रत हलीमा का जिक्र है जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम की पालनहार थीं। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरा महत्व रखता है और दया, सहानुभूति और निस्वार्थता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: حلیمه
in_pashto.meaning: حلیمه د مهربانه او فداکار ښځې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حلیمه د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی چې د مهربانه او فداکار ښځې معنی لري. دا نوم د قرآن کريم په سورت القصص آيت 7 کې ياد شوی دی، چيرته چې د حضرت حلیمة د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم د دايې په اړه يادونه شوې ده. دا نوم په اسلامي دوديزۍ کې ژور اهميت لري او د رحم، شفقت او فداکارۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Halimah
in_english.meaning: Halimah means a merciful, compassionate, and caring woman
in_english.long_meaning: Halimah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning a merciful, compassionate, and caring woman. The name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Qasas, Verse 7, referring to Halimah, the foster mother of the Prophet Muhammad. It holds deep significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing mercy, empathy, and selflessness. The name reflects qualities of kindness, nurturing, and maternal love.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: حلیمه

data.cultural_impact: The name Halimah is of Arabic origin and is beautifully rendered in various translations to mean 'gentle', 'patient', 'forbearing', and 'kind'. In Middle Eastern cultures, it is considered a virtue to be patient and there is a deep appreciation for those who exhibit patience and forbearance above and beyond the ordinary. The name Halimah would therefore carry in its wake an air of subtle respect and admiration.
data.spiritual_significance: Halimah is associated with the spiritual stature of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) from the Quran. Prophet Yusuf was known for his steadfastness and fortitude, which allowed him to maintain his faith in the most difficult of trials. In one instance, he forgave his brothers who had sold him into slavery and had since repented. It is said that the forgiveness he showed was a manifestation of his deep spiritual maturity. The name Halimah signifies this level of spiritual forbearance and can be seen as a reminder of the importance of patience, forgiveness, and steadfastness in life. 'Indeed, patience is not from the fate of the ignorant.' [Quran 12:96]
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Patient, Forbearing" symbolizes A name that embodies the qualities of patience and forbearance, as mentioned in the Quran.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Halimah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of patient, forbearing.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.context: Umm Halimah bint Abi Al-As was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and was known for her generosity and hospitality. She was the mother of the famous companion, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas.
